name: manual_534ac1
claim: State in soul cards, READMEs and schema descriptions only what the code and tests enforce. An adversarial reviewer found four doc-versus-code contradictions in one diff: a seat id the validator rejected, a claim that every attempt is recorded when recording was opt-in, a soul card saying the validator rejects any card touching policy when it checked one field, and a schema note implying checks the validator lacked. Prefer a test that reads the document, so wording and behavior cannot drift apart.
conditions: documentation claims enforcement parity soul card schema

decisions.notes: 2026-11-17: all eight reviewer findings reproduced against the code before fixing; the fixes added tests that read the soul cards, README and schema for the corrected wording.

rationale: 2026-11-17: all eight reviewer findings reproduced against the code before fixing; the fixes added tests that read the soul cards, README and schema for the corrected wording.
